card.title: 506th AIRBORNE
card.flavorText: The 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment (506th PIR) is an airborne light infantry regiment of the United States Army. During WWII the regiment was attached to the 101st Airborne Division and participated in the D-day landings, Operation Market Garden, and the Battle of the Bulge. The 506th Airborne were the subject of the HBO miniseries Band of Brothers.
